title: Contour objects
description: A rounded contour changes between three sculptural silhouettes.
useCase: Explain related shapes, states or identity marks while preserving visual continuity.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Path interpolation requires compatible command structure and browser support for CSS d. Unsupported interpolation still updates the SVG d attribute to the correct selected shape.
look: A soft beige-to-taupe gradient blob with a cream outline and drop shadow on a dusty blue background, above a translucent pill segmented control.
motion: Choosing a contour morphs the SVG outline to its path through a 700 ms CSS d transition (ease-in-out); keyboard selections snap instantly.
adapt: The morph is `transition:d .7s` on `.sculpture path`, with each entry of `paths` applied as both the `d` attribute and a CSS `d` style. Replace `paths` with shapes sharing one command sequence (M, four C, Z) and recolour the gradient stops.
